name: tiziano-ai
description: Specialist skills and tools for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.name: charter-skills
plugins.description: Specialist methods for product, design, engineering, research and creative work. An opinionated, Mac-first skill library.

plugins.name: deck-studio
plugins.description: Shape a story and deliver HTML, PDF and native editable PowerPoint with narrative guidance and 56 visual systems.

plugins.name: voices
plugins.description: Create reusable voices, audition speech and export the performance you selected on your Apple Silicon Mac. Requires your own local Voices CLI and models.

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: Create narrated films from real web-product use and revise retained footage. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac, the separate Walkthrough CLI, Node 24, FFmpeg and local Voices with provisioned models and a saved narrator. Setup explicitly acquires dependencies and a browser; installing this guidance starts no recording or inference. Remotion and model terms apply separately.

plugins.name: grokpair
plugins.description: Delegate bounded work to a detached Grok Build collaborator while your agent keeps working, then review its replies and files.

plugins.name: cloudflare-publish
plugins.description: Give local HTTP(S) or pinned SSH services stable, protected hostnames through your own Cloudflare Tunnel and Access.

plugins.name: t3-workers
plugins.description: Delegate tasks to visible T3 workers from Codex or Claude Code. Alpha.

plugins.name: t3-workflow-relay
plugins.description: Run any agent of a Claude Code workflow on another T3 account or provider, in its own T3 thread. Alpha.
